title: End-To-End Clo Virtual Series | Webinar 02: Design Proto - Ideate, Create & Review
description:
Webinar 02: Design Proto - Ideate, Create & Review

This webinar will help you:
   1. Enhance your design workflow with advanced tools
   2. Ideate smarter and faster
   3. Iterate quickly and effectively
   4. Plan your product range more efficiently

Time Stamps:
00:00:00 - Introduction
00:09:37 - CLO-set hierarchy
00:19:33 - Content Statistics
00:23:32 - Visual Board
00:31:20 - Pattern Drafter
00:33:03 - Pen tool pattern
00:33:51 - 3D Pen Avatar
00:34:38 - Tip and Tricks - 1 - Set Sublayer belt
00:35:20 - Fabrics and Textures
00:37:02 - Tips and tricks 2 - Seamless blocking
00:38:29 - AI studio
00:40:50 - Tips and Tricks 3 - Overseamline
00:42:04 - Tips and Tricks 4 - CLO FAB
00:43:22 - Modular Mode
00:46:28 - Tips and Tricks 5 - Lettuce hem
00:48:28 - Colorways
00:49:48 - View 3D design
00:54:49 - 3D Viewer
00:56:27 - Design Review
01:01:23 - Quality Standardization
01:05:27- 3D Quality Check in CLO-set
01:08:09 - Corrections
01:09:03 - Configurator
01:13:59 - Design Range Review
01:21:32 - Conclusion

About the End-to-End CLO Virtual Series: 
A set of workflow-based webinars incorporating all the new CLO features to optimize your entire 3D product development process.

Webinar series line-up:
     1. Webinar 01: Custom Asset Library - Create & Manage 
     2. Webinar 02: Design Proto - Ideate, Create & Review
     3. Webinar 03: Fit Proto - Create & Review
     4. Webinar 04: Production Ready
     5. Webinar 05: Marketing & E-Commerce

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://discord.gg/SSPtURg6hj
